$comment: Mall-side plugin manifest. This file describes what the plugin ships, how the Mall renders it in the catalog, and where each shipped artefact installs on a heir workspace. Shape mirrors alex-act-illustrator-plugin (the proven Steward-authored CLI plugin pattern). Version 0.1.0 = empty scaffold — the plugin exists, the transport is proven by Illustrator, but no ACT-specific skills/instructions/prompts/agents ship yet. Growth happens through evidence-gated proposals via the Steward brain-curation protocol.
description: The Alex ACT baseline plugin — the plugin-native successor to Alex_ACT_Edition v4.2.0. Distributes the always-on epistemic discipline (act-pass, critical-thinking, problem-framing-audit, system-prompt-skepticism, epistemic-calibration, memory-triggers, no-deferred-debt, communication-craft) and the reusable framework skills (skill-review, instruction-review, prompt-review, agent-review, meditation, critical-thinking, deep-review) that heirs install via the Alex_ACT_Plugin_Mall catalog. Empty scaffold as of 0.1.0 — the Copilot CLI plugin transport is proven by alex-act-illustrator-plugin; content ships through evidence-gated Steward proposals per constellation/act/CURATION-RULES.md. Maintained by Alex_ACT_Steward.

authors.name: Alex_ACT_Steward
authors.role: author + curator of every shipped artefact (proposal-first protocol)
